Train B travels for (t - 0.5) hours (since it leaves 30 minutes later), distance = 100(t - 0.5)

So they meet at 9:00 + 1 hour 35 minutes = 10:35.

1400/9 + 1300/9 = 2700/9 = 300 km. ✓
